signal_definition: one binary above-own-75th-percentile observation per unit that ran; -1 means unobserved
hidden_summary_interpretation: 64 learned scalar features; not a 64-bit payload
notes: The default is sized for under 1% theoretical matmul overhead on 1.7B at 1K context; measure wall time separately
First two LLM layers are always dense; the last two observation positions do not predict another layer
Observation bits are NOT causal-importance labels or direct instructions to skip weak units
Prediction targets, loss, and matched evaluation budgets are defined in Phase 0, not trained in this stage
